items.wordHook: 但(but) + 是(be) → 但是 means 'but'.
好(good) + 了(change) → now good, so getting well.
學(learn) + 校(school) → the place for learning: 學校(school).
Under the 宀(roof), the 示(altar) displays the family's ancestral tablets; that honored place is 宗(ancestry).
對(face) + 不(not) + 起(up) → unable to face you: 對不起(sorry).
A sound-match for 'chocolate' → 巧克力(chocolate).
A corner under the 广(broad) roof is 占(occupied) by a shop sign → the 店(shop).
Walking with each 彳(step) shows how an action goes, using the 㝵(dé) cue to assess: 得(complement marker).
When the bright 日(sun) disappears and only faint 音(sound) echoes across the black night → 暗(dark).
比(compare) + 賽(compete) → comparing and competing is a 比賽, a competition.
a 石(stone) rolls down a 宛(crooked) path and lands as a 碗(bowl).
a 穴(cave) swallows a 囪(chimney) → 窗(window).
a 竹(bamboo) rod rests on the 目(eye) line as 廾(two hands) count → ready to 算(calculate).
臺(platform) + 灣(bay): a platform by a bay → the island of Taiwan.
Combining 資(wealth) and 源(spring): 資源 means resource s.
Combining 零(zero) and 食(food): 零食 means snack, junk food.
